title: Add optional production quality judge provider injection

output.summary: Approve optional production judge provider and prompts.

approvedRows.question: DTR-quality-judge-provider
approvedRows.currentState: The independent judge substrate exists and is fake-tested, but production wiki facades do not yet resolve an optional configured judge provider.
approvedRows.desiredState: Production wiki_decide, wiki_plan, and wiki_implement attempts resolve an optional HTTP judge provider through config/env, use versioned prompts, and preserve deterministic behavior when disabled.
approvedRows.rationale: The provider boundary makes independent review usable in production attempts without adding a required model dependency.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users can get stronger semantic QA when they opt into a judge worker, with no default slowdown or model dependency.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get a stable config/env boundary and prompt version before integrating a real provider.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Small bounded provider/config/prompt integration with local HTTP fake tests and no default behavior change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Production wiki facades resolve optional judge providers through config/env and remain disabled by default.
Judge requests include versioned prompt templates for independent quality review.
Tests prove env-configured HTTP judge injection can affect a production wiki_decide attempt.

approvedRows.recommendationRationale: The change is optional, tested with a local fake HTTP worker, and default-off.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: The user approved making the judge substrate usable from production loop attempts without a required model dependency.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Completes the provider boundary needed for independent non-deterministic checks.
agentAssessment.rationale: Optional HTTP provider injection keeps CodeWiki-owned semantic authority while allowing external evidence from judge workers.

approvedRows.currentPain: A real judge worker cannot be attached through configuration, and prompt/version contract is not explicit.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: Operators can opt in to an HTTP quality judge worker while default local execution remains deterministic and dependency-free.
approvedRows.successSignal: Tests prove default disabled behavior, env HTTP config, prompt construction, production wiki_decide judge injection, and config validation.
nonGoals: Do not add a built-in model provider.
Do not enable judge checks by default.
Do not require a judge for deterministic hard gates.

implementationAssessment.maintainability: Judge provider logic is isolated in src/loops/judge-provider.ts with config validation in project config and facade injection kept small.
implementationAssessment.simplicity: The provider is default-off and uses built-in fetch against an HTTP endpoint; no provider dependency is bundled.
implementationAssessment.projectStyle: Matches existing config/env patterns and keeps CodeWiki semantic authority over verdict mapping.
implementationAssessment.errorHandling: HTTP errors, missing verdicts, and judge failures become blocking judge results through the existing evaluator path.
implementationAssessment.uncertaintyResolution: Typecheck, targeted tests, full tests, build, lab reports, audit, and diff hygiene passed.
implementationAssessment.rationale: This makes judge workers attachable without changing deterministic default execution.

sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.security: No endpoint is enabled by default; operators must opt in through config/env.
sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.privacy: Judge requests are sent only to configured endpoints and contain compact standard/evidence metadata.
sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.rationale: The provider boundary uses explicit opt-in HTTP and remains disabled by default.
